verdict.rationale: Proa is a Rust web framework. Its components, templates and props are typed Rust, installed via cargo, and its islands emit plain vanilla JS, so a TypeScript version-support matrix is a category error for this product. Nothing in the evidence shows any TypeScript surface, such as typings for the Node FFI, that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As a developer, I know which TypeScript versions the framework officially supports so I can avoid compatibility breaks when upgrading either one
